Name: Fabrication: Pressure Regulator for the <Alias=TargetLocation> on <Alias=TargetPlanetLocation>
MissionBoardDescription: Local Contract. Build a pressure regulator for the <Alias=TargetLocation> on <Alias=TargetPlanetLocation> and deliver it by hand. Payment on delivery.

LogEntries.Entry: The water reclaimer at the <Alias=TargetLocation> lost its pressure regulator. Nobody out there can make another, and they've been rationing water since.
I've built the pressure regulator the <Alias=TargetLocation> needs. Now I need to take it out to them by hand.
I built the <Alias=TargetLocation> a pressure regulator and handed it over. They'll have running water within the hour.

Objectives.DisplayText: Build a pressure regulator at a workbench
Deliver the pressure regulator to the crew lead at the <Alias=TargetLocation>

Lines.ResponseText: You've got the regulator? Please say you've got the regulator. The old one was older than me. Nobody out here can make them.
That's exactly it. Give me an hour and we'll have running water again.
What happened to the old one?
Nothing dramatic. It just stopped one morning.
Nobody out here has the parts. The last one came in a crate with the reclaimer.
Emergency tanks and a lot of not washing. Everything tastes of the tank. I've stopped noticing, which is worse.
I'd offer you a drink, but the water's off.
You're close? Come and find me. We've been rationing water for a week. You're the best news we've had.
